about: Depth haze (r211, format 9): FOG layers with a shaderHaze mix every layer of their page behind them toward the mist's white (0.93, 0.95, 0.97), 1 - (1 - haze)^n at n layers back, in every repeat mode, through a SEQUENCE layer, two mists stacked, and a cross-fade while tinting. Written by core/test-data/haze/make_round.py. Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.

scenes.name: haze-repeat-X
scenes.about: c01 (repeat X): the mist between the two front layers hazes the five behind it by 0.25 a step (Simon's r208 start), a WAVE among them

scenes.name: haze-repeat-XY-sequence
scenes.about: c02 (repeat X and Y, padded) with q02's SEQUENCE layer, scrolling up at 30 units/s: a padded mist of haze 0.35 in front of the cycle hazes it and every image behind

scenes.name: haze-repeat-Y-two-mists
scenes.about: c03 (repeat Y, mirrored copies), scrolling up at 30 units/s: a mist of 0.2 in front of a FOG hill of 0.15, the layers behind both mixed by the two

scenes.name: haze-no-repeat
scenes.about: c05 (no repeat): a mist of 0.3 in front of FOG and WAVE layers, a WAVE with no wavelength hazed all the same

scenes.name: haze-cross-fade-tinted
scenes.about: h01 cross-fading into itself (its layers cloned) while tinting orange: each page hazes its own layers, faded and tinted, the haze's white untinted
